textes.chargement.sans_commande: v%s loaded, but no slash command is free. See the log messages.
textes.sous.ouvrir.desc: opens the Grimoire Addon Manager window
textes.sous.version.desc: version, language and number of entries
textes.sous.journal.desc: latest log messages (log clear to empty it)

textes.ouvrir.bientot: The window arrives in a later step of the project.
textes.version.ligne: Grimoire Addon Manager v%s, interface %s, language %s, %d entries, %d categories, %d profiles.
textes.commandes.aucune: No command is active. Add one with: commands add name
textes.commandes.invalide: Invalid command name: %s (letters and digits only).
textes.commandes.deja: Command /%s is already in the list.
textes.commandes.absente: Command /%s is not in the list.
textes.commandes.usage: Usage: commands add name, or commands remove name.
textes.fiche.absente: No entry for this add-on yet.
textes.liste.case_categorie: Enable or disable the whole category
textes.fiche.invite: Pick an add-on in the list to read its sheet.
textes.pied.attente: %d change(s) pending: reload to apply them.
textes.acces.minicarte_aide: Click: open or close. Drag: move the button.
textes.sous.taille.desc: starting size of the window (large, medium, compact)
textes.sous.mini.desc: switches between the full and the mini version
textes.journal.police_absente: Font not found (%s): game font used.
textes.edition.aide: Your version overrides the starting file (language: %s).
textes.lien.aide: Ctrl+C to copy, Esc to close.
textes.lien.absent: No known CurseForge address for this add-on.
textes.reglages.aucun: No known settings to open for %s.
textes.reglages.inactif: %s is not loaded: enable it, then reload.
textes.reglages.erreur: Could not open the settings of %s.
textes.sous.fiche.desc: tooltip and sheet parts (sheet tooltip off, sheet note on…)
textes.fiche.usage: Usage: sheet tooltip on|off, or sheet <part> on|off. Parts: %s.
textes.barre.options_aide: Adjust Grimoire Addon Manager (display, sort, search, commands…).
textes.sous.options.desc: opens the options (options game: the Esc menu page)
textes.sous.chercher.desc: searches the add-ons (search fishing, search /way, search #pvp)
textes.sous.tri.desc: list sort (name, category, state, memory, usefulness; reverse)
textes.sous.etiquette.desc: tags of an add-on (tag Name pvp, to test)
textes.sous.favori.desc: favorites (favorite Name to add or remove; no name: the list)
textes.sous.desinstaller.desc: "to remove" list (remove Name to add or take off)
textes.sous.sansfiche.desc: list of add-ons without a sheet
textes.sous.vus.desc: marks new and updated add-ons as seen
textes.cherche.usage: Usage: search a word, a command (/way) or a tag (#pvp).
textes.etiquette.usage: Usage: tag Name tag1, tag2 (no tag: clears them).
textes.favori.vide: No favorite. Click a row's star, or: favorite Name.
textes.desinstaller.liste: To remove (then do it in CurseForge): %s
textes.vus.fait: New and updated add-ons marked as seen.
textes.journal.option_reinit: Settings reset to their starting values.
textes.opt.page_aide: The same settings are in the window: Options button.
textes.opt.cmd.vide: No command: the add-on can then only be opened with the minimap button.
textes.opt.cmd.aide: Names separated by spaces, Enter to apply.
textes.opt.acces.bouton_menu_echap: Open from the Esc menu AddOns button
textes.opt.liste.recherche.garder: Keep the search after a reload
textes.sous.erreurs.desc: opens the Lua error window (errors clear to empty it)
textes.sous.cpu.desc: CPU measuring mode (cpu on, cpu off, cpu reset)
textes.erreurs.resume: %d different errors, %d in total, %d add-ons involved
textes.erreurs.choisir: Pick an error in the list.
textes.erreurs.desactive: Error capture is off (option "Record Lua errors").
textes.memoire.titre: Memory: %s in total for %d loaded add-ons (top %d):
textes.memoire.aucune: No loaded add-on has measured memory.
textes.cpu.eteint: CPU measuring mode is off. Type /%s cpu on, then /reload (the game runs a bit slower while it is on).
textes.cpu.demande: Measuring mode requested: type /reload to apply it.
textes.cpu.coupe: Measuring mode switched off: type /reload to get normal speed back.
textes.cpu.deja: The measuring mode is already in that state.
textes.cpu.attente: Measuring mode requested but not active yet: type /reload.
textes.cpu.titre: CPU for the last %s: %.1f ms in total, top %d:
textes.cpu.aucune: Nothing measured yet: play for a while, then run the command again.
textes.cpu.rappel: CPU measuring mode is on: the game is slower. /%s cpu off to switch it off.
textes.opt.erreurs.masquer_fenetre_jeu: Hide the game's own error window
textes.opt.erreurs.son: Small sound on each new error
textes.opt.erreurs.taille_pile: Characters kept of the call stack
textes.opt.erreurs.memoire_alerte: Warn when memory goes over a limit
textes.opt.erreurs.cpu_rappel: Remind me that measuring mode is on
textes.profil.tout_note: Turns on everything made for Forever (your locks stay).
textes.profil.rien_note: Turns everything off, except locked add-ons and this manager.
textes.profil.erreur_max: Too many profiles: delete one first.
textes.journal.profil_fusionne: Profile "%s" added to the current setup: +%d, -%d.
textes.journal.profil_enregistre: Profile "%s" updated with the current setup (%d add-ons).
textes.journal.profil_importe: Copy/paste: %d profile(s) and %d other item(s) imported.
textes.profil.import_vide: Nothing to import: paste a text first.
textes.profil.import_invalide: This text is not a Grimoire Addon Manager profile (it must start with MAA1).
textes.profil.contenu: Turns on %d add-ons (%d chosen in the profile).
textes.profil.difference: Compared to now: +%d to enable, -%d to disable.
textes.profil.absents: Incomplete: %d uninstalled add-on(s): %s. The "Remove missing" button drops them.
textes.profil.portee_tous_info: Also applies to the %d other character(s) the manager already knows.
textes.profil.confirme_supprimer: Delete profile "%s"? It cannot be recovered.
textes.profil.confirme_fusion: Add "%s" to the current setup: +%d enabled, nothing disabled (%d).
textes.profil.fusionne: "%s" added to the current setup: +%d, -%d (%d character(s)). Reload to take effect.
textes.profil.applique: "%s" applied: +%d, -%d (%d character(s)). Reload to take effect.
textes.profil.cree: Profile "%s" created from the current setup.
textes.profil.enregistre: "%s" now keeps the current setup (%d add-ons).
textes.profil.exporte_tout: Full backup ready: copy the text (Ctrl+C).
textes.profils.aide: Pick a profile, check what changes, then Apply. Reload afterwards.
textes.situation.texte: Situation: %s. Switch to profile "%s"? (+%d, -%d, with reload)
textes.profil.alerte_absents: %d add-on(s) of profile "%s" are no longer installed (command: profile clean).
textes.verrou.pose: %s is locked: no profile will turn it off.
textes.sous.profil.desc: Applies a profile: profile <name>, profile all <name>, profile new <name>...
textes.sous.verrou.desc: Locks or unlocks an add-on (never turned off by a profile).
textes.opt.profils.confirmer: Show what changes before applying a profile (+x / -y)
textes.opt.profils.dependances_auto: Also turn on a profile's dependencies
textes.opt.profils.proposer: Suggest the linked profile in a dungeon, raid or battleground
textes.opt.profils.dependances_facultatives: Also turn on optional dependencies (e.g. Baganator turns on Syndicator)
textes.sous.activer.desc: Turns an add-on on with its dependencies and modules: enable <add-on>.
textes.sous.desactiver.desc: Turns an add-on and its modules off: disable <add-on>.
textes.sous.seul.desc: Turns everything off except this add-on, its dependencies and the locked ones: only <add-on>.
textes.sous.essai.desc: Turns an add-on on for one session only: trial <add-on> (no name: the list).
textes.sous.depannage.desc: Safe mode: turns everything off except the named add-ons and the locked ones.
textes.sous.retour.desc: End of safe mode: puts everything back as it was.
textes.sous.recharger.desc: Saves the choices then reloads the interface.
textes.sous.perimes.desc: Load out-of-date add-ons: outdated on|off (no word: toggle).
textes.sous.annuler.desc: Undoes the last change made in the list.
textes.sous.resume.desc: One line: add-ons, profile, pending changes, errors.
textes.actions.usage_activer: Say which add-on to turn on: enable <add-on>.
textes.actions.usage_desactiver: Say which add-on to turn off: disable <add-on>.
textes.actions.usage_seul: Say which add-on to keep: only <add-on>.
textes.actions.active: "%s" turned on with its dependencies and modules (%d change(s)). Reload to apply.
textes.actions.desactive: "%s" turned off (%d change(s)). Reload to apply.
textes.actions.seul: Only "%s" stays on (with its dependencies, the locked ones and this manager): +%d, -%d. Reload to apply.
textes.actions.essai_vide: No add-on on trial. Say which one to try: trial <add-on>.
textes.actions.essai_debut: "%s" turned on for one session: it will be turned off at the next login. Reload to try it.
textes.actions.essai_arret: "%s" is no longer on trial (it stays on).
textes.actions.essai_termine: Trial over for %d add-on(s): %s. They will be turned off at the next reload.
textes.actions.depannage: Safe mode: everything is off except %d named add-on(s), the locked ones and this manager (+%d, -%d). Reload, then "back" to restore everything.
textes.actions.depannage_deja: Safe mode is already on: type "back" to put everything back as it was.
textes.actions.retour: Safe mode over: everything is back as it was (+%d, -%d). Reload to apply.
textes.actions.usage_perimes: Say outdated on (load out-of-date add-ons) or outdated off (check them).
textes.actions.perimes_non: Out-of-date add-ons will not be loaded.
textes.journal.actions_essai: "%s" put on trial for one session.
textes.journal.actions_essai_termine: Trial of "%s" over: turned off for the next reload.
textes.resume.depannage: safe mode on (back to restore everything)
textes.opt.actions.maj_clic: Shift + click on a box: with modules and dependencies
textes.sous.antiseche.desc: opens the cheat sheet: every command, a click types it in the chat (cheatsheet <word> to search)
textes.sous.visite.desc: starts the guided tour of the window (5 bubbles)
textes.aide.astuce_maj: Click: types the command in the chat · Shift + click: runs it right away
textes.aide.astuce: Click: types the command in the chat
textes.aide.redimensionner: Drag to make the window bigger or smaller
textes.opt.aide.regrouper: Cheat sheet: how to sort add-on commands
textes.visite.fini: Tour finished. To see it again: /%s %s. For the commands: /%s %s.
textes.visite.liste.texte: One line per add-on. Tick the box to turn it on or off: nothing changes until you press Reload. Shift + click also turns on its dependencies; right-click opens an action menu.
textes.visite.categories.texte: Filters the list by topic (maps, combat, bags…). Add-ons without a sheet are filed separately.
textes.visite.fiche.texte: Click an add-on: its sheet says what it is for, which commands it knows and what to keep in mind. You can add your own note or fix the text.
textes.visite.entete.texte: A profile turns a whole set of add-ons on at once (dungeon, leveling…). The button on the right switches the window to the mini version (list only) and back. The "?" opens the command cheat sheet.
textes.visite.pied.texte: Changes wait here: "Undo" reverts them, "Reload" applies them. Type /%s %s to see every command, or click the "?".
textes.raccourci.antiseche: Open or close the cheat sheet
textes.raccourci.mini: Switch between mini and full version
textes.opt.aide.visite_auto: Start the guided tour on first launch
textes.opt.aide.executer_maj: Shift + click on a cheat-sheet command: run it
textes.opt.aide.montrer_eteints: Also show commands of turned-off add-ons
textes.opt.aide.detecter: Spot commands the sheets do not mention
textes.sous.diag.desc: checks the uncertain points of the game (functions, images, settings) and records the result
textes.diag.sect.guid: Enable / disable for a specific character (GUID)
textes.diag.guid_aucun: no other known character to test with
textes.diag.sauve: Result saved (read it with the journal or tell Claude).
textes.diag.parchemin: sheet title: color %.2f %.2f %.2f, text opacity %.2f, effective %.2f, level %s (parent %s)
textes.liste.entete_aide: Click: fold or unfold the category
textes.opt.avances_aide: Everyday settings are shown; tick to also see the fine-tuning ones.
textes.barre.vue_aide: Click: “All add-ons” grouped by category, or as a single list.
textes.diag.parchemin_resume: sheet summary: colour %.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f, alpha %s, parents %s, layer %s, text “%s”
textes.sous.trace.desc: records where every part of the window is on each click (for debugging); type again to stop
textes.trace.on: Trace on: click what misbehaves, then /reload to save it. Type the command again to stop.
textes.fiche.note_aide: Click in the box to type; arrows to move, Escape to leave.
textes.bouton.tout_activer_aide: Ticks every add-on made for the game (then Reload). Undo goes back.
textes.bouton.tout_desactiver_aide: Unticks every add-on except Grimoire Addon Manager (then Reload). Undo goes back.
textes.barre.filtre_aide: Click: choose which add-ons to show.
